artist.name: Cian Ducrot
artist.short_description: Cian Ducrot is an Afterglow discovery artist in the broader emotional-pop and songwriter catalogue.
artist.biography: Cian Ducrot is an Irish singer-songwriter whose dramatic pop ballads combine piano-led songwriting with a strong sense of emotional address. His early releases included Make Believe and the widely heard 'All For You' and 'I'll Be Waiting.' The album Victory appeared in 2023, followed by Little Dreaming in 2025. Some of his music uses personal family relationships as its source: he has explained that 'Heaven' was written as a thank-you to his brother, while describing 'All For You' as having multiple meanings that he prefers listeners to interpret for themselves. This reluctance to pin down every song to a single story is itself relevant to Afterglow's editorial approach. Instead of presenting one fixed interpretation as fact, an artist page can show the source-supported context alongside an explicitly identified editorial reading. Other songs in the proposed ten-track starter set span loss, complicated attachment and reconnecting with the past. He is a useful cross-recommendation alongside Dean Lewis, Henry Moodie and Jamie Miller for visitors drawn to big emotional vocal performances.
